Verbatim leaf_map_get_leaf_bounds faces branch (leaf_map.c:637+) over the fixture face (node 0, zero vertices) and test-supplied counts 2 and 3: bounds stay the CE null rectangle (center 0, radius inf) identical to the no-face leaf. Only the vertexless path is exercised; project_point2d is a stub that aborts if reached, so face vertices are not covered here (other lane owns vertex debug-draw fixtures).

Verbatim structure_material_convert (port/linux/game/custom_edition_geometry.c:760+) with rasterizer stubs recording destination offsets and bytes. Fixture DATA block read as the compress destination when vertex count is nonzero. Finding (parity holds, contract gap): CE writes vertex_count*56 bytes into the uncompressed block without checking its size; the 4-byte synthetic block overruns for one vertex (OVERRUN need=56 have=4 in CE and oracle). The HCU consumer must bound-check or the validator must reject such counts.
